item.title: 【Helpdesk】[Tutorial] How to download Music & Music Videos from iTunes/Apple Music for cheap (US Region)
item.description:
I want to post this bot for people who are looking for an easy and cheap way to download what you need from iTunes & Apple Music. (Just $2 p/m)

PinkMusicBot, a Telegram bot that can download Music & Music Videos from iTunes/Apple Music with no re-encoding by just pasting the link.

All tracks from this service are guaranteed bit-perfect.

With the free tier, you can only download lossy iTunes Plus AAC.
Or, by paying $2 p/m, you can unlock premium and access the rest of the features listed below:

-Music
AAC (iTunes Plus): 256kbps | CVBR | 44.1kHz
Apple Spatial Audio (AAC): 256kbps | CVBR | 48kHz
ALAC (Lossless): up to 24-bit | up to 192kHz
Dolby Atmos: 768kbps | CBR | 48kHz

-Music Videos
480p to 2160p
H264 - 1080p or below
HVEC - new 1080p videos & all 4k
All audio formats supported

Note: Not all tracks on iTunes/Apple Music have a lossless (ALAC) copy to stream, only AAC!!

Also, ALL audio & video files will retain all metadata as if you had purchased them from the store!

This bot will download from the United States region ONLY, it will reject any other.
- - -
1) Download Telegram for any device here.

2) Once you have installed Telegram and have signed in, add the bot by using this invitation.

3) Once you have added the bot, use the /membership command to view and purchase a membership.

4) Simply paste a valid US region url and the bot will get to work!
- - -

This is NOT an ad nor am I receiving any commission / kickback for talking about this bot.
(I pay for and use this regularly for iTunes exclusives)
It’s just one of the few places where you can download from iTunes/AM without using complicated software and/or command line.
(Don’t ban me plz! )

(for those looking for a possible free option, yams.tf used to offer this service, but have since stopped. They may again in the future)

Hope this helps someone!
